verdict.rationale: Ramp ships a extensively documented Developer API (174 OpenAPI paths spanning transactions, bills, cards, funds, purchase orders, reimbursements, vendors, treasury, custom records) plus CLI/MCP surfaces that mirror many UI actions, and the docs explicitly note where a gap exists (e.g., 'Bill approvals aren't yet available via MCP — use the Ramp UI or the Blank Canvas Approvals API for now'), which shows the API layer still covers it even if one agent channel doesn't yet. However, several UI-only features (travel booking/hotel rebooking automation, AI contract parsing in procurement, some accounting-sync workflows) are never confirmed as API-exposed, so full 1:1 parity isn't demonstrated. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that every UI-only feature (travel, procurement AI parsing, hotel rebooking) has an API equivalent, and independent verification of full parity beyond vendor docs.
